challenge.title: Have a Product Idea but Haven't Built It Yet?
challenge.description: Ideas are easy to imagine. Turning them into working products is where the real challenge begins.
items: You have a product idea but don't know how to build it without coding.
You've tried no-code tools but haven't connected them into a working application.
You want to use AI in a product but don't know how to integrate it.
You want to build something real instead of watching another set of tutorials.
You need a focused timeline and a clear goal to move from idea to execution.

items.title: Is there a program fee?
items.description: No. There is no program fee for the 30 candidates selected for this simulation.

items.title: Can anyone join the program?
items.description: Anyone who meets the published eligibility criteria can apply. Admission is limited to candidates shortlisted through ROAC's internal assessment.

items.title: Do I need coding experience?
items.description: No prior coding experience is required. The simulation is designed around no-code development.

items.title: Does applying guarantee a seat?
items.description: No. All applicants must complete the selection process. Only 30 candidates will be admitted.

items.title: What will I build in 30 days?
items.description: You will work towards building a functional no-code product, with a focus on testing and production readiness. The outcome depends on your project and completion of the program requirements.

items.title: Will I have to pay for tools separately?
items.description: Any tool costs or third-party subscriptions, if applicable, will be communicated to candidates before participation.
